title: Lipids annotation of Nano-DESI MSI
author: yang1832
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bm2qk8dw
materials: Create mass list from the averaged spectrum.
Obtain DDA MS/MS data from each sample.

steps.title: Annotate m/z values via LIPIDMAPS
steps.instruction: Use the LIPIDMAPS bulk structure search (https://www.lipidmaps.org/resources/tools/bulk_structure_searches.php?database=COMP_DB) to annotate each m/z value with the following criteria: Positive‑mode adducts [M+H]+, [M+Na]+, [M+K]+; Negative‑mode adduct [M‑H]‑; Mass tolerance 0.005 m/z; Restrict to even‑chain lipids only.

steps.title: Filter assignments with diagnostic fragments
steps.instruction: Apply diagnostic fragment ions and characteristic neutral losses to narrow down peak assignments, then discard any assignments that do not match the CID spectrum.

substeps.instruction: Use diagnostic fragments and characteristic neutral loss to refine assignments.
Remove assignments that do not match the CID spectrum.

steps.title: Calculate and filter by ppm error
steps.instruction: Calculate the ppm error for each remaining assignment and eliminate any assignment with an error greater than 5 ppm (most assignments typically have errors <3 ppm).

substeps.instruction: Calculate ppm error for each assignment.
Remove assignments with ppm error >5 ppm.
